    @pytest.mark.description("Test case for validating form submission from coach portal")
    @allure.title(f"Given User has submitted SDOH form, When coach checks this user on coaches portal, Then Coach should be able to see user submitted SDOH form response under User profile-SDOH section")
    def test_validateSubmittedSDOHForm_fromCoachPortal(self):
        _, auth_token = self.createSession(config.get_login_credentials()['usernameCoach_1'], config.get_login_credentials()['passwordCoach_1'])
        assert auth_token is not None, "Failed to create session"
        print("Auth token received:", auth_token)
    
        chrome_options = Options()
        chrome_options.add_argument("--headless=new")
        chrome_options.add_argument("--window-size=1920,1080")
        self.__class__.driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=chrome_options)
        self.driver = self.__class__.driver
        self.driver.get(os.getenv('coach_url', config.get_coaches_url()))
        self.driver.execute_script("localStorage.setItem(arguments[0], arguments[1]);", "token", auth_token)
        self.driver.refresh()
        self.driver.get(f"{os.getenv('coach_url', config.get_coaches_url())}app/cohort/automationForLogclass/users/{self.userId}/profile")

        self.driver.find_element("xpath", "//a[text()='Accept']").click()
        wait = WebDriverWait(self.driver, 10)
